_help: The speech bubble over the player (official MapleStory art, UI/ChatBalloon.img/0). Game pixels in 1366x768. w = the bubble width. maxLines = how many lines of the message the bubble shows (a longer message is cut short). lineH = the height of one line. padX/padY = the gap between the text and the bubble border. lifeMs = how long the bubble stays on the screen. aboveFeet = how many pixels above the feet the bubble bottom sits. tailDx = how far left of the feet the tail tip lands (the tail points at the head).
